verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's updates changelog gives dated, advance deprecation notices: the legacy `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` names will be discontinued in three months, and an alias mapping applies in the meantime. The changelog also announces new versioned models such as V4.1 Flash and an experimental Vision-Exp. This shows deprecation handled in practice, but through ad-hoc notices rather than a formal written policy. missing for 10: a formal published deprecation/sunset policy with guaranteed notice periods, explicit API versioning scheme (endpoint/date versions) and stability guarantees, independent corroboration of how deprecations play out.
